memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Some time later, the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt offended their master, the king of Egypt. Pharaoh was angry with his two officials, the chief cupbearer and the chief baker, and put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, in the same prison where Joseph was confined. The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he attended them. After they had been in custody for some time," - Gen 40:1-4 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Two important men from Pharaoh's court — his chief cupbearer and chief baker — fall out of favour and land in the very prison where Joseph is held. And the captain of the guard assigns them to Joseph's care: "he attended them." Joseph, an unjustly imprisoned slave, becomes the servant of two disgraced officials in a dungeon.

Notice what Joseph does: he serves. He does not sink into bitterness or refuse to lift a finger because life has been unfair. He simply takes up the task in front of him and does it well, attending to these men day by day. The same faithful spirit that had marked him in Potiphar's house now marks him in prison.

There is a quiet greatness in this. Joseph did not know that these two men held the key to his future, that serving them would one day open the door to the palace. He simply served faithfully where he was, without any guarantee of reward.

We often want to know how a task will pay off before we commit to it. But faithfulness means serving well right where God has placed us, even when we see no benefit and receive no thanks. Do the work in front of you with excellence. You never know how God may use the humble service of today to shape the story of tomorrow.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do I serve faithfully even when I see no reward?
2. Am I doing the task in front of me with excellence?
3. Could God be using my present service in ways I cannot see?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, help me to serve faithfully right where You have placed me, even without reward or recognition. Give me Joseph's steady spirit to do well the task in front of me today. Amen.
